title: SB2456 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/SB2456_.HTM; sha256 cfb8c1f8b914939087141ab58619c12638dd5d22dccc74ac6224b9dd9c1f81c7)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Section 1 (HRS 134-2(j)) and Section 3 (HRS 134-7.3(d)) only update cross-references to the renumbered subsections of 134-7. Violating (d) stays a misdemeanor under the amended penalty subsection. No votes on file.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-7): (d) No person who has been twice convicted within ten years of committing the offense of operating a vehicle under the influence of an intoxicant in violation of section 291E-61 shall own, possess, or control any firearm or ammunition therefor.
